result.brief: 提出复合子空间流匹配（CSFM）自监督表征学习目标，通过谱、颜色、光照子空间的确定性退化课程实现方差最小化反演，得到线性可分且可生成反演的潜空间。
result.reason: Proposes composite subspace flow matching as a self-supervised representation learning objective yielding linearly separable yet generatively invertible latents, directly addressing visual representation learning and generative latent space.
